fields.name: TileX

fields.name: OpaqueZ
fields.meaning: Copied into intermediate; game uses Z0; new editor heart/portal/gate serializers initialize Z0.

fields.name: OpaqueFlags
fields.meaning: WORD ORed into intermediate24; neither inspected callback consumes it after conversion/checksum. Preserve raw.

fields.name: Direction
fields.meaning: BYTE: game only applies it for terrain37;0/2/4/6 set orientation0/1/2/3. Others leave existing orientation unchanged but still call refresh. Editor gates33/37 copy full byte.

fields.name: OpaqueByte
fields.meaning: Not copied by converters. New editor heart/portal/gate serializers do not assign it; existing raw model records retain it. Unknown historical purpose.

fields.name: InitialHealth
fields.meaning: Unsigned WORD, per-type rules below; no universal byte width or100 clamp.

fields.name: TerrainIdSelector
fields.meaning: Baseline RoomType enum uses Terrain IDs, not catalogue RoomId. Portal12 corresponds to standalone RoomId3; heart14 toRoomId5.

fields.name: PlayerId
fields.meaning: Game only tests nonzero; it does not assign owner in this callback. Editor looks up a player with this byte, then may override stored gate player to1.

parser.read: If declared payloadBytes!=20, zero20-byte raw buffer then read declared length; callback path does not cap the length. Bounded API accepts0..20 and zero pads, preserving physical raw length for patches. Oversized reads are not executed.
parser.conversion: Six presenceDWORDs0..14 ->1. XYZ18..20, flagsWORD24 OR prior, directionBYTE26, healthWORD28, terrainBYTE2A, playerBYTE2B. IntermediateBYTE27 remains from seed; rawBYTE0F never copied. Parsers zero-initialize intermediate.

game.meaning: Overlay for an already existing tile/room; callback contains no room creation. Raw PlayerId0 returns1 before checksum/position. Otherwise center XY/Z0, call world virtual200; nonzero proceeds to tile lookup1D4, checksum44, then require tileWORD2&0FFF nonzero and resolve entity via6EE540.

type_branches.portal12: If healthWORD!=100 compute health delta and call4E5300; exactly100 skips helper.
type_branches.heart14: Pass full healthWORD to4DB700. This helper creates/updates heart objects, not a simple room health field; whole helper side effects are outside fixtures.
type_branches.gate37: For directions0/2/4/6 set runtimeDWORD9B=0/1/2/3; every otherBYTE preserves old value. All directions then invoke4EF6C0 refresh. Other selectors, including33/34/40, return without applying CC properties.

game.health_delta: p=signed32(low32(currentRoomHealthDWORD35*(100-rawHealthWORD))); high=signed64(p * -1374389535)>>32; q=high>>5; delta=low32(q+(q<0)). For ordinary positive values this is the negative truncated percentage reduction; rawWORD>100 can produce positive delta and multiplication can overflow32 bits.
game.ownership: Player byte is only a gate in this game callback. Do not infer ownership reassignment or a comparison against actual room owner. Health helper receives existing roomWORD1D, not rawPlayer.
game.ignored: Raw Z/flags affect the44-byte checksum input only after position passes; rawBYTE0F is absent from intermediate. No complete checksum uniqueness or original opaque purpose inferred.

Editor callback comparisons exclude precisely this one byte of freshly constructed records; all256 player bytes and other19 record bytes are compared. Preallocated arrays avoid heap growth; no full allocation or map-load/GUI process claimed.

limitations: 136 emulations:18 parser,3 converter,67 full game callback,35 full editor callback with native lookup/add/resolve and preallocated arrays,3 heart serializer,10 full Things writer. Game validity/tile/checksum/rebuild/health helpers are explicit fixtures; actual final health, geometry, room ownership and heart object creation are not simulated.

Direction cardinal names NORTH/EAST/SOUTH/WEST remain baseline labels; native control flow establishes the four raw values and runtime orientation mapping. It does not independently calibrate world north.
Native editor terrain-match is not a game callback check. Game does not compare selector to actual existing room type, so diagnostic APIs must not turn that into an invented native guarantee.

Six corpus selector34 records have no applying branch in inspected editor/game callbacks. This does not prove complete map load/save removes them: other loading phases can populate models from map cells. Independent codec retains every record.
Raw Z/WORD0C/BYTE0F retain unknown original purpose; observed ignored/discarded paths do not justify automatic zeroing. All patch/rebuild work is in memory; original files unchanged.
